energy_accounting.study_energy_disclosure: Direct circuit-board current sensors on Jetson Thor, microcontroller cycle counters, and M.2 thermal physics bounds.

claims.statement: Living cells use sixty-four genetic triplets to store survival rules, and digital six-input lookup tables use the exact same sixty-four switches.
Grouping four neighboring switch settings together absorbs small sensor or wording glitches while eliminating brittle high-frequency noise.
A sixteen-kilobyte core runs verified skills in nanoseconds from four-dollar microcontrollers to fanless M.2 circuit cards, waking large models only on genuine novelty.
Headline outcome: 125–176 nJ Board Sensor · 38 ns Cycle · 55.2 °C M.2 Bound (Direct circuit-board current sensors on Jetson Thor, microcontroller cycle counters, and M.2 thermal physics bounds.)

easy_read.easy_title: Nature's 64-Switch Code on Tiny Cool Chips
three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about nature's 64-switch code on tiny cool chips.
Living cells use sixty-four genetic triplets to store survival rules, and digital six-input lookup tables use the exact same sixty-four switches.
Grouping four neighboring switch settings together absorbs small sensor or wording glitches while eliminating brittle high-frequency noise.
A sixteen-kilobyte core runs verified skills in nanoseconds from four-dollar microcontrollers to fanless M.2 circuit cards, waking large models only on genuine novelty.
Key result: 125–176 nJ Board Sensor · 38 ns Cycle · 55.2 °C M.2 Bound.
Real power sensors on the circuit board measured the electricity.
